dedupe_keys.name: statistics denmark employed persons by municipality of residence and area of workplace pend100 commuting matrix statbank api

description: PEND100 is Statistics Denmark's register-based commuting matrix: the number of employed persons at the end of November each year by municipality of residence and area (municipality) of workplace, split by sex, for 2008 to 2024. It belongs to the home-to-work commuting statistics, which Statistics Denmark says are comparable in their current form from 2008 onwards and measure commuting between place of residence and workplace within Denmark. Companion tables AFSTA4 and AFSTB4 give average commuting distances. Coverage: all Danish municipalities, with workplaces outside Denmark as a separate category in the destination list. Format and access: the StatBank API returns the table as JSON, CSV, PX or Excel without registration; the last update was on 18 November 2025. Licence: free commercial and non-commercial use with a source reference, which Statistics Denmark states corresponds to CC BY 4.0. Caveats: flows are between municipalities only, with no mode of transport, and distances and flows describe the workplace recorded for the job, not daily travel diaries. Simulation uses: origin-destination matrices for national and regional transport demand models, calibration of commuting in agent-based models and daytime population for exposure. Related records: the Statistics Denmark dwelling tables, the Czech census commuting flows and the US ACS commuting flows.
